verdict.rationale: Slate is a built-in AI assistant/agent (CLI-based) that users delegate coding and research tasks to directly, with orchestration of subagents, built-in programs like goal/deep-research, and automatic model selection. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification of delegation quality (community evidence raises skepticism about output quality rather than confirming the delegation mechanism works well), and no detailed walkthrough of a full delegated task lifecycle.
